description_en: Suitable for unstructured text recognition. Supports returning both the recognized text content and its position coordinates.
description_zh: 适用于非结构化文字识别，支持返回文字内容和位置坐标信息
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-general --url https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20250102/oqzwva/%E9%80%9A%E7%94%A8%E6%96%87%E5%AD%97%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeGeneral

parameters.help_en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive—you must provide one and only one of them.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
* 本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空
* 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive—you must provide one and only one of them.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
* When invoking via software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh:
* 本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
* 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
* 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
